judgment.rationale:
The only available evidence collector — getModelCard — returned null, indicating that no model card exists for the "churn-predictor-v1" model deployed at "churn-predictor-endpoint". 

Control RA-3.v1 requires a substantive risk assessment that covers: (a) identification of threats and vulnerabilities, likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access/use/disclosure/disruption/modification/destruction, and adverse effects on individuals from PII processing; (b) integration with organizational risk management; (c) documented risk assessment results; (d) periodic review; (e) dissemination to defined personnel; and (f) updates upon significant changes.

A model card is the primary artifact in an ML governance context where risk assessment documentation, intended use, limitations, and risk ratings would be recorded. Its complete absence means there is no evidence of any risk assessment having been conducted, documented, reviewed, disseminated, or maintained for this model. None of the six sub-requirements of RA-3 can be confirmed as satisfied.
